parsed.reason: Every specific is backed by the research notes: Psychotherapy Referral Service, EAP sessions, extended health coverage, Ontario Structured Psychotherapy, Family Service Toronto's sliding scale, ConnexOntario's 24-hour number and Distress Centres' 24/7 support. Nothing is invented. It opens warmly and includes crisis support, so the care is there. Calling ConnexOntario the place to go 'if it gets urgent' is a slight stretch, since it is an information and referral line. Overall it reads more like a dense resource roundup than a quick text from a friend, though it still answers directly.
